As of August 2026, the category has consolidated into five recognizable groups: credential brokers built for coding agents (Kontext CLI is a Go-based example), agent identity vaults that give agents their own email addresses and secret stores (AgentLair is representative), enterprise privileged access platforms extending into agentic infrastructure (Teleport, AWS Bedrock AgentCore Gateway), consumer-grade password managers adding delegation features (1Password with Keycard), and open-source sandboxing tools (Nono) that isolate what an agent can reach in the first place.
